children: Boohoo Group can now fully focus on scaling the platform without any capital constraints, Peel Hunt's John Stevenson and Jonathan Pritchard write in a note. The U.K. clothing retailer has delivered another robust performance update, they say, as its turnaround continues. Additionally, the sale of its Sheffield distribution center has transformed the company's outlook, effectively clearing debt, they add. Shares in Boohoo Group, which trades as Debenhams, are up 3% at 25.25 pence. (najat.kantouar@wsj.com)
